decisions.decision: Pin split MCP v2 client/core/server/node 2.0.0, legacy SDK 1.30.0, ext-apps 1.7.5, and conformance 0.2.0-alpha.11.
decisions.rationale: A loopback spike proved exact modern stateless and bounded legacy negotiation; normative dates remain protocol authority.

decisions.decision: Use a dedicated web-client double-iframe sandbox proxy with no direct Tauri authority.
decisions.rationale: This gives app content an opaque origin and keeps privileged operations behind authenticated host brokers.

decisions.decision: Use version-1 typed messages/context/schema/stream/cancel/intent/budget contracts with host-selected provider and no tools or fallback.
decisions.rationale: Apps need stable structured inference without credentials or internal provider objects.

decisions.decision: Limit each active installation to 1 CPU, 512 MiB, 1 MiB output, 120 second requests, 30 second startup, and 3 restarts at 1/2/4 seconds.
decisions.rationale: These bounded ceilings match accepted Spec 04 supervision policy and require owner retry after exhaustion.

decisions.decision: Ship verified compiled JavaScript on BrainDrive's packaged Node runtime behind a runtime-neutral supervisor.
decisions.rationale: This reuses the existing packaged runtime while keeping the control contract portable.

decisions.decision: Close the MVP feature matrix; reject Sampling and defer prompts/completions, OAuth, stdio, subscriptions, Tasks, and elicitation.
decisions.rationale: No accepted Resume Builder story needs those facilities.

decisions.decision: Require Docker dev and claim native Windows first; keep macOS and Linux configured but unclaimed.
decisions.rationale: Only selected targets with ground-truth release evidence may be claimed.

repository_discrepancies.decision: Treat MCP 2026-07-28 as stateless: no initialize/initialized exchange or Mcp-Session-Id; logical host connection IDs remain local authorization/cache identities.
Do not invent the missing builds/mcp_release test:integration entrypoint; use its existing test and build commands and record live conformance separately.
